tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
ALL TERMS AND CONDITIONS ARE AS PER TENDER DOCUMENTS.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder must have the experience for providing specified House Keeping Services (Cleaning parson &Ward Boy) and Security Service (Security Head Guard& Security Guard) in the last three years (2023-24, 2024-2025 2025-2026) to any Government Hospitals (above 500 bedded hospitals) / Organizations (Satisfactory Work Done certificates should be submitted)
License to engage in business of private Man-power agency issued by the Police Department
Certificate of Registration of establishment issued by Department of Labour
GST registration allotted by tax authorities. GST paid details with Latest challans.
Annual Turnover Statement for last 3 years Certified by Charted Accountant

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: EPF Registration certificate and EPF paid details with Latest challans
ESI Registration certificate where-ever applicable shall be produced. ESI paid details with Latest challans.

The bidder must not have defaulted in providing House Keeping Services Cleaning parson &Ward Boy and Security Service Security Head Guard& Security Guard against previous work award declaration in this regard shall be uploaded
The Bidder should not have any cases against him regarding non-payment of EPF & ESI etc., Declaration in this regard shall be uploaded
The Bidder should not have been blacklisted as on date of bid opening. Self Declaration in this regard shall be uploaded
